chunks: ʿĀṣim ibn Ḥumayd narrated from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I asked Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام about a man who performs tawaf and saʿy, then performs voluntary tawaf around the House before he shortens his hair. He said: “I do not approve of it.”

key_terms.بِالْبَيْتِ: around the House, meaning the Kaʿbah
key_terms.تَطَوُّعًا: voluntarily, as a non-obligatory devotional act
key_terms.مَا يُعْجِبُنِي: I do not approve of it, expressing disapproval
key_terms.يَسْعَى: he performs saʿy, walking between al-Ṣafā and al-Marwah
key_terms.يَطُوفُ: he performs tawaf, circling the Kaʿbah as a ritual act
key_terms.يُقَصِّرَ: he shortens his hair, referring to taqsir in pilgrimage rites

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to perform a voluntary tawaf before taqsir after tawaf and saʿy?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses a legal ruling related to the rites of hajj or ʿumrah. Imam Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام expresses disapproval of performing an additional voluntary tawaf before completing taqsir, indicating the importance of observing the proper order of ritual acts.
